author: Alice Chen
text: Morning all. Fleet uptime last week was 97.2% across 42 AMR-7 units. The all-hands moves to Wednesday 10:00 PT this week and doubles as the weekly fleet sync.

author: Eli Brooks
text: Filed ACME-231: AMR-7 gripper loses calibration after an overnight power cycle. Seen on AMR-7-04, AMR-7-09 and AMR-7-11 at the north warehouse; night shift has to re-home them by hand.

author: Farah Haddad
text: Proposal: stop the Friday 16:00 fleet-wide firmware push. From Monday 12 Oct every release goes to a canary ring of 5% of the fleet for 24 hours, and only then to the rest if the pick error rate stays flat. Tracking in ACME-240. @Alice Chen can you sign off?

author: Alice Chen
text: Approved. We go with the canary ring from Monday 12 Oct. Farah owns the rollout process; Dana, 4.8.1 is the first release through it.

author: Dana Okafor
text: Firmware 4.8.1 is code-complete. It carries the encoder-offset fix for ACME-210 and will be the first build through the canary ring on Monday.

author: Bob Rivera
text: Cycle count in aisle 12 tonight: please keep robots out of aisle 12 between 22:00 and 02:00. Tracked in ACME-238.

author: Bob Rivera
text: Night shift recap: 3 pick-station stoppages overnight, all gripper calibration on AMR-7 units after the nightly power-down. Eli has the logs on ACME-231.

author: Alice Chen
text: Board update draft is linked from the Leadership Offsite Agenda page. Headline: 97.2% fleet uptime and two new warehouse customers in Q3. Site expansion details stay in my own notes until the board meeting on 14 Oct.

author: Alice Chen
text: I am out Thursday afternoon for the board pre-read. Farah is the escalation point for anything fleet-related.
